notes.title: About the update patch of 2021/6/6
notes.notes:
The 2021/6/6 patch fixes several bugs, optimizes some fluency, and improves frame rate.
1. Fixed 8 security vulnerabilities.
2. Fixed 5 misalignment vulnerabilities affecting the game experience.
3. Fixed 1 compatibility error (located in Windows 8)
4. Fixed the problem that Qihoo's software 360 security guards detected a virus. (Due to the use of part of the false report and user report submission, there is no Trojan horse virus)
5. Fixed the blue screen caused by memory usage during runtime, saving some resources.
6. Music enhancement.

notes.title: 2021.5.30 update description
notes.notes:
1. Fixed some translation errors in the English version
2. Modified the style of the start interface (Chinese and English versions are different)
3. Fixed the bug that some levels in the Chinese and English versions could not pass
4. Strengthen the Chinese version's sense of strike, and increase the Chinese version's attack and knife sound effects
5. Fixed a number of unique errors in the English version, and multiple dislocations.
6. Modified part of the UI, such as text boxes, dialog boxes, etc.
7. Enhance security and prevent some cheating.
8. Enhance the stability of the English version (instability due to some reasons)

notes.title: English compatibility comes out, and 82 bugs that affect the game are fixed!
notes.notes:
This update allows English-speaking players to play smoothly, and we have fixed more than 80 bugs that affect the game experience.
Our 11-year-old developer Xiong Hao Sicheng said: "The English and Chinese versions have been successfully launched. Japanese, French, and German versions may be released this summer. There is no development plan for the new version, and we actively accept your opinions."

notes.notes:

notes.notes:
The development of the latest version is coming to an end. We hope you can experience a different and wonderful game. We also want to respect the opinions of your fans, experience the game and decide whether to buy it or not. The purpose of this activity is to let you have an in-depth experience of killer 19 and put forward suggestions to make our game better and better.
Xiong haosicheng, a 12-year-old developer, will show you the first horizontal action plot game developed by primary school students. As a major developer, he will explain the latest killer 19 one by one and give you an eye opener.
